scope: Optional mechanistic comparator specified while the new scheduled runs were in flight, before inspecting their returned answers or fresh outer scores. Use exactly the three registered scheduled tasks and only their first eligible frozen input. No new training or API calls.
rule: Compare the campus review with always measuring the already-planned confirmation. Select the option with the lowest precomputed required delta (tie-break by challenger identifier). Use its original minimum, requiring a strictly positive third-fold difference and a row-weighted gain of at least 0.003 across all three folds. If it passes, independently reload the challenger's existing primary model for interim predictions; otherwise use the current pointer.
report: Number of matched forks, whether interim predictions differ from the live policy, fresh held-out balanced accuracy for the local arithmetic decision and ordinary control, and the costs. No accuracy on the profiled n71 replay. Interpret separately from the preregistered main comparison. Never choose an option from a later score.
